'SMD -0.06 [95% CI -0.23, -0.11]; p=0.46) ( Table 2; Extended data, Figu': Estimate -0.06 lies outside its own 95% CI [-0.23, -0.11].

findings.evidence: Methods: 'A restricted maximum likelihood (REML) random-effects model was used'. code/forest.R before-after loop calls rma(measure='SMD', m1i=..., data=datS) with no method= argument (metafor default is REML for rma.uni, so the estimator matches but is not stated in code); the exercise-vs-usual-care loop sets method='REML' explicitly.
